record.what_it_does: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform providing APIs to manage email/SMS campaigns, customer profiles, events, flows, catalogs, and analytics for ecommerce and marketing teams.
record.auth_notes: Private API keys (header `Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key ...`) are the simplest self-serve method and are used for most `/api` endpoints. OAuth2 is what Klaviyo recommends for third-party/tech-partner integrations acting on behalf of multiple accounts, and is required to be listed in Klaviyo's App Marketplace. A third 'public key' method (6-character company ID passed as a query param) is only for client-side, non-sensitive event/subscription tracking and isn't suitable as an agent auth method.
record.access_notes: Anyone can sign up for a free Klaviyo account (up to 250 profiles / 500 emails per month) and immediately generate a private API key from Settings > API keys with no approval step, per the pricing and authentication docs.
